reason: I might play with the free demo pet for a few days because I like keeping streaks, but I'm not signing up to let an AI move my real retirement money, and I don't even know which broker it would be or what it costs.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money. Asking ChatGPT a question is one thing, but letting it invest and pay for me is another, and a cute pet makes it feel more like a game than something I'd trust with real savings.
would_change_my_mind: Knowing the licensed broker partner by name, with my account insured like it is at my robo-adviser, plus a few months of watching the demo agent behave sensibly before any real money is involved.
